title: Crunchy Shrimp Wrap
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired shrimp wrap, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until pink and fully cooked.
Remove the shrimp from the pan and set aside.
Add the melted butter to the pan and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for 1 minute, or until slightly softened.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by placing the cooked shrimp in the center, then topping with the scallion mixture and a sprinkle of cilantro.
